options.en: very keen to start something at once
too tired to keep on working
sure that you are always right

why.en: Reluctant means not willing: you do not want to do it, so you do it slowly or not at all.
why.uz: Reluctant — biror ishni qilishni istamaydigan: uni sekin qilasiz yoki umuman qilmaysiz.
why.ru: Reluctant — не желающий что-то делать: делаешь это неохотно или не делаешь вовсе.

stem.en: According to the text, who planned the clean-up?

why.en: The text says two older pupils noticed the rubbish and planned everything themselves.
why.uz: Matnda ikki katta oʻquvchi axlatni koʻrib, hammasini oʻzlari rejalashtirgani aytilgan.
why.ru: В тексте сказано: двое старших учеников заметили мусор и сами всё спланировали.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Aziz has no money to give, but he can still ___ by painting the posters."

why.en: After "can" we need a verb: to contribute is to give your time or help.
why.uz: «can» dan keyin feʼl kerak: contribute — hissa qoʻshmoq, yaʼni vaqt yoki yordam berish.
why.ru: После «can» нужен глагол: contribute — вносить вклад, отдавать время или помощь.

options.en: the thing that matters most to you
a short meeting with your teacher
the cheapest way to travel to school
a mark you get for very good work

why.en: Your priority is the thing that matters most to you, so you deal with it first.
why.uz: Priority — siz uchun eng muhim narsa, shuning uchun u bilan birinchi shugʻullanasiz.
why.ru: Priority — то, что для вас важнее всего, поэтому этим занимаются в первую очередь.

stem.en: According to the text, why is a scholarship Timur's first priority?

options.en: His family cannot pay high fees.
He wants to study near his home.
His teacher told him to get one.
Engineering is a very short course.

why.en: The text says his family cannot pay high fees, so a scholarship comes first.
why.uz: Matnda oilasi yuqori toʻlovni toʻlay olmasligi aytilgan, shuning uchun stipendiya birinchi oʻrinda.
why.ru: В тексте сказано, что семья не может платить высокую плату, поэтому стипендия на первом месте.

stem.en: Choose the word: "The road was closed and the bus was late, but we ___ arrived at the stadium."

why.en: Between "we" and "arrived" we need an adverb: eventually means in the end, after a delay.
why.uz: «we» va «arrived» orasida ravish kerak: eventually — oxir-oqibat, kechikishdan keyin.
why.ru: Между «we» и «arrived» нужно наречие: eventually — в конце концов, после задержки.

options.en: able to be trusted to do things well
very good at making other people laugh
too busy to help other people
new to a job or to a place

why.en: A reliable person can be trusted to do things well: never late, never forgetting a task.
why.uz: Reliable — ishonchli odam: ishni yaxshi bajaradi, kechikmaydi, vazifani unutmaydi.
why.ru: Reliable — надёжный человек: на него можно положиться, он не опаздывает и ничего не забывает.

stem.en: According to the text, what did Jasur do with his income?

options.en: He saved it for a laptop.
He gave it to his parents.
He spent it on English classes.

why.en: The text says he saved his small income for a laptop.
why.uz: Matnda u kichik daromadini noutbuk uchun yigʻgani aytilgan.
why.ru: В тексте сказано, что он откладывал свой небольшой доход на ноутбук.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Before she accepted the job, Madina tried to ___ a better salary with the manager."

why.en: After "tried to" we need a verb: to negotiate is to talk until both sides agree.
why.uz: «tried to» dan keyin feʼl kerak: negotiate — kelishguncha muzokara qilmoq.
why.ru: После «tried to» нужен глагол: negotiate — договариваться, пока стороны не придут к согласию.

options.en: facts that show something is true
a guess about what will happen
a list of the tools you need in a lab
a prize for the best project

why.en: Evidence is facts that show something is true; a guess is not evidence.
why.uz: Evidence — dalil, yaʼni biror narsa toʻgʻriligini koʻrsatadigan faktlar; taxmin dalil emas.
why.ru: Evidence — доказательства: факты, которые показывают, что что-то верно; догадка — не доказательство.

stem.en: According to the text, what did the girls find after four weeks?

options.en: Both groups grew about the same.
The plants with music grew faster.
Half of the seeds did not grow.

why.en: The text says both groups were almost the same height after four weeks.
why.uz: Matnda toʻrt haftadan keyin ikkala guruh deyarli bir xil boʻyda boʻlgani aytilgan.
why.ru: В тексте сказано, что через четыре недели обе группы были почти одной высоты.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Before every match, my grandfather likes to ___ which team will win."

why.en: Saying before a match who will win is talking about the future: we predict it.
why.uz: Oʻyindan oldin kim yutishini aytish — kelajak haqida gapirish: predict (bashorat qilmoq).
why.ru: Сказать до матча, кто победит, — значит говорить о будущем: predict (предсказывать).

options.en: a story that may not be true
a funny picture you send a friend
a list of your marks at school

why.en: A rumour is a story that people pass on, although it may not be true.
why.uz: Rumour — mish-mish, yaʼni odamlar tarqatadigan, lekin rost boʻlmasligi mumkin boʻlgan gap.
why.ru: Rumour — слух: история, которую передают друг другу, хотя она может быть неправдой.

stem.en: According to the text, what did Nilufar find on the school's page?

options.en: the dates of the new holidays
a message from the head teacher
a photo of the class chat

why.en: The text says that when she checked the school's own page, there was nothing about the holidays.
why.uz: Matnda u maktab sahifasini tekshirganda, taʼtil haqida hech narsa yoʻqligi aytilgan.
why.ru: В тексте сказано, что на странице школы ничего не было о каникулах.

stem.en: Choose the word: "This website never says where its facts come from, so I do not trust it as a ___."

why.en: A place that information comes from is a source; we trust or do not trust a source.
why.uz: Maʼlumot olinadigan joy — source (manba); manbaga ishoniladi yoki ishonilmaydi.
why.ru: Место, откуда берётся информация, — source (источник); источнику доверяют или нет.

options.en: to keep something in good condition
to sell something that you do not need
to move something to a new place

why.en: To maintain something is to keep it in good condition, for example by repairing and cleaning it.
why.uz: Maintain — biror narsani yaxshi holatda saqlamoq, masalan taʼmirlab, tozalab turmoq.
why.ru: Maintain — содержать в хорошем состоянии, например ремонтировать и чистить.

stem.en: According to the text, who looks after the garden?

why.en: The text says every family takes turns to water the trees and maintain the benches.
why.uz: Matnda har bir oila navbat bilan daraxtlarni sugʻorib, oʻrindiqlarni parvarish qilishi aytilgan.
why.ru: В тексте сказано, что каждая семья по очереди поливает деревья и следит за скамейками.

stem.en: Choose the word: "On hot afternoons our cat sleeps in the ___ under the apricot tree."

why.en: A cool, dark place out of the sun is the shade: the cat sleeps in the shade.
why.uz: Quyoshdan panada salqin joy — shade (soya): mushuk soyada uxlaydi.
why.ru: Прохладное место без солнца — shade (тень): кошка спит в тени.
